svg.title: One trade, seven stages
svg.desc: 1 idea, from you. 2 evidence, from the Market Analyst, Research Analyst and Strategist. 3 risk sign-off: the Risk Manager sizes the trade and issues the ticket. 4 your approval, by ticket id. 5 one send, by the Execution Trader, the only Bot with the key. 6 reconciliation: the Execution Trader confirms it from the exchange record. 7 review: the Trade Reviewer grades process and outcome separately.
svg.text: The Desk Lead keeps every trade on this path
Six Bots share the Trading Floor; the Trade Reviewer works by DM
